fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShip.*Run|TestShipLand|TestWatchdogPRNoCI' shows the ship record naming the run after ship.open-pr, ship.check, ship.land and ship.rebase run under one RHIZA_RUN, naming a second run after that run's ship.check on the same change set, and naming the run the watchdog acted for after its no-CI merge of main pushes the PR
fields.statement: Each ship step that opens, checks or pushes a change set's PR (ship.open-pr, ship.check, ship.land, ship.rebase, and the watchdog's merge of main on behalf of a run) records in the change set's ship record the run it ran for (RHIZA_RUN, or the run the watchdog acted for), so the record names the run that opened or last pushed the PR
